anchors.cell_block_centre: origin on the centre of a cell block at floor level (rooms, bridge, hangar, ceilings)
anchors.cell_centre: origin on one cell's centre at floor level (corridors, deck tiles, lifts)
anchors.cell_edge: origin on a cell boundary midpoint at floor level (bulkhead frames across a corridor)
anchors.door_anchor: origin on the room.gd door anchor: 0.4 m in from the room edge = 0.6 m behind the inner face
anchors.free: footprint-centred free prop (any position on the floor)
anchors.terrain_tile: origin on an 8 m terrain tile centre; edges typed ground(level) / ramp / cliff / trail
anchors.viewer: sky backdrop centred on the viewer (look.backdrop or a far region piece)
anchors.wall_face: back on a wall's inner face at floor level (vents, wall terminals, lockers); back_m = back offset

connectors.rule: facing sockets on the same cell edge; width 3.0 m
a door socket takes exactly one stn.doorway frame (room.gd places it from the room's door data via the arch.door binding); stn.airlock may add its leaves as an insert
a window cut takes the stn.viewport of the same kind
wall-face props on wall sockets, back on the wall face (back_m)
neighbouring tiles share an edge with the same type and level (ramps: same from/to, trails on both sides)

grid.note: room plot = cells x 4 m + 0.5 m apron each side; door.position for side cell i = 4*i + 2; terrain tiles 8 m on the region plot
